verdict.rationale: AgentMail has no first-party natural-language interface. However, its hosted MCP server exposes inbox, message, thread, draft and attachment tools to any compatible client, so a user can run the product by natural language through a third-party LLM agent. The CLI removes the need to write code, but it is command-based rather than natural-language. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, docs showing end-to-end natural-language workflows, and independent or hands-on proof that natural-language operation via MCP works.
